question: What most likely caused the authentication outage?

evidence.text: A configuration deployment completed at 14:01 UTC.
Token validation errors reported an unexpected issuer.
Rolling back the deployment restored service at 14:19 UTC.

units.text: Failures began one minute after the configuration deployment completed.
The deployment likely changed the token issuer configuration.
The outage was caused by a bad issuer configuration introduced in the deployment.
It is unknown why pre-deployment validation did not catch the issuer mismatch.
